scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/.next apps/*/.turbo apps/*/node_modules/.cache packages/*/node_modules/.cache .turbo node_modules/.cache
scripts.clean:nuclear: rm -rf apps/web/.next apps/docs/.next apps/storybook/.next apps/storybook/storybook-static apps/*/.turbo packages/*/.turbo .turbo node_modules/.cache apps/*/node_modules/.cache packages/*/node_modules/.cache
scripts.clean:nuclear:full: pnpm clean:nuclear && rm -rf node_modules && pnpm install
scripts.check:all: pnpm guardrails && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check-types
scripts.quality: pnpm check:all && pnpm turbo run build --filter=web --filter=@trappsystems/site --filter=@readboot/site
scripts.quality:full: pnpm quality && pnpm turbo run build-storybook --filter=storybook
